key_insight: Blood-based metabolic profiles plus AI showed promise for distinguishing children with ASD from those with other developmental delays in a clinically relevant diagnostic setting.
clinical_relevance: If validated in larger studies, this approach could help support earlier ASD diagnosis during developmental evaluations.
method: Double-blind case/control study at two developmental pediatric clinics.
Collected blood metabolic profiles from 140 children (18–60 months) on a diagnostic waitlist.
Compared AI-based predictions against gold-standard clinical assessment (ADOS, MSEL, VABS) and DSM-5 diagnosis.
evidence_signal: In the reported cohort, AI classification using measured metabolites achieved over 80% accuracy for ASD vs non-ASD samples.
watch_item: Results need replication in larger and more balanced cohorts, especially with more non-ASD developmental delay cases, before clinical implementation.
paper_title: Translational Study of using FOCM/TS Metabolites for Supporting Autism Spectrum Disorder Diagnosis
